Your risk of getting fired from job is the highest |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/jobs/working-in-delhi-your-risk-of-getting-fired-from-job-is-the-highest/articleshow/59159053.cms?from=mdr |access-date=2024-08-13 |work=The Economic Times |issn=0013-0389}} It is publicly traded on both the [[National Stock Exchange of India|National Stock Exchange]] (NSE) and the [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE).{{Cite news |date=2017-06-21 |title=TeamLease flowered in Bengaluru because it's a city of ideas: founders |work=The Times of India |url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/startups/companies/teamlease-flowered-in-bengaluru-because-its-a-city-of-ideas-founders/articleshow/59250948.cms |access-date=2023-10-12 |issn=0971-8257}} TeamLease is involved in various sectors, including training, staffing, and other HR services. It also runs a Vocational University and the National Apprenticeship program. By 2006, TeamLease had a workforce of over 30,000 associates. In 2009, the company secured funding amounting to $500 million.{{Cite web |title=TEAMLEASE Company History |url=https://stock-financials.valuestocks.in/en/teamlease-company-history |access-date=2023-10-12 |website=Dynamic Levels |language=en-US}} In 2010, TeamLease made an acquisition, taking over IIJT, an IT company based in Navi Mumbai with a network of 120 centers across India. extract:
TeamLease Services Limited is an Indian recruitment and human resources services company established in 2000 with its headquarters in Bengaluru, Karnataka. The company operates nine offices across India, with locations in Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Delhi, Ahmedabad, Kolkata, Hyderabad, Chennai, and Bhubaneshwar. It is publicly traded on both the National Stock Exchange (NSE) and the Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
TeamLease is involved in various sectors, including training, staffing, and other HR services. It also runs a Vocational University and the National Apprenticeship program. It is a Fortune India 500 company.
